Fix `packages/element/tests/textStyles.test.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. packages/element/src/textStyles.ts now returns the canonical colorToHex form (lowercase #rrggbb) from its colour sanitizers and caps getUniformTextRangeStyle, shiftTextRangesAtOffset and splitTextIntoStyledSegments at MAX_TEXT_RANGES. (1) Existing test 'rejects unsafe, overlong, or transparent colors and keeps valid CSS colors' fails: AssertionError at textStyles.test.ts:93 -- expected value still has raw `color: "red"` and `color: "rgb(1,2,3)"`; change ONLY those two expected values to `color: "#ff0000"` and `color: "#010203"` (inputs unchanged; every other assertion unchanged). (2) Add a test: normalizeTextRanges([{start:0,end:4,color:"url(#x) rgb(1,2,3)"},{start:4,end:8,highlight:'rgb(1,2,3)" onload="x'}], 10, "#1e1e1e") equals [{start:0,end:4,color:"#010203"},{start:4,end:8,highlight:"#010203"}]. (3) Add a test: with a 50,000-entry overlapping input (e.g. Array.from({length:50000},(_,i)=>({start:i%50,end:50+(i%50),color:i%2?"#e03131":"#1971c2"}))) on a 100-char text, each of getUniformTextRangeStyle(input, 0, 100, "color"), shiftTextRangesAtOffset(input, 10, 0, 5) and splitTextIntoStyledSegments(<its real signature: read textStyles.ts>) completes in under 1000 ms (performance.now()) and returns the same result as calling it on input.slice(0, MAX_TEXT_RANGES). Read textStyles.ts for each function's exact signature; import any new names from the module path the file already imports from.
